overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the board secretary's separate calls to two members sought agenda input rather than a quorum's deliberation, though staff emails copying a quorum can invite comment on agenda substance.

allegations.summary: Complaint said two members deliberated outside open session when the board secretary polled them by phone on an executive session item for union negotiations.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board members who spoke with Ms. Noe were conveying their personal opinions to a staff member for use in formulating an agenda for the meeting, and did not intend their communications with her to reach a quorum of the Board.
